fact: 本章没有叙述框架，由**三个日期的短记**直接拼成：Sunday, April 18, 2010（Beck is 34, Clare is 38，署「Beck:」）、Saturday, April 24, 2010（署「Clare:」）、Sunday, May 30, 2010（署「Beck:」）。第三个日期末尾还接了一小段「a few days later」，没有另起日期。
quote: Sunday, April 18, 2010 (Beck is 34, Clare is 38) ... Beck: ... Saturday, April 24, 2010 ... Clare: ... Sunday, May 30, 2010 ... Beck:
anchor: Speculations Upon the Nature of Love

fact: 4 月 18 日，Beck 先列他原本在等的那个人：男人、黑人、比他年长、高、黑到「night-in-human-form」、诗人、爱狗爱小孩、艺术家、「sex personified」、「my male twin」、「Blacker than the heart of the universe before the big bang」，是一个能承接他怒气的「fighter-lover」、一个许他三个愿望的 jinn——他自己结句说这是「an impossibility」。
quote: The person I imagined is a man, is Black, is slightly older than me, is tall, is so Black he is night-in-human-form, is a poet, is a force to be reckoned with ... a jinn who would offer me three wishes: an impossibility.
anchor: She is not the obvious person

fact: 实际遇到的是 Clare：耐心、悲伤、「so white」、灰眼睛里带着戒备的寡妇；她的女性气质是「an unexpected lure, a sweet prize I never knew I craved」，她的白是「a barrier, a hurt, a question I can't answer」。她把秘密都讲给 Clare 听，Clare 听、Clare 懂；他发现自己一直在想她在做什么、她是否也在想他。
quote: Instead I found Clare—so patient, so sad, so white: a widow with a guarded expression in her gray eyes ... Her femininity is an unexpected lure, a sweet prize I never knew I craved. Her whiteness is a barrier, a hurt, a question I can’t answer.

fact: 他怀疑「这是爱吗」：太容易了，没人欲擒故纵，问什么 Clare 就答什么，不会露出「你早该知道」的神情；她把他介绍给她的朋友，他也带她和表亲在 O'Hare 附近吃午饭（表亲转机），饮料还没上大家已经一起说笑。他觉得「It's too good to be true」。
quote: Is it love? It feels too easy—no one is playing hard to get, no one is trying too hard ... we meet my cousins for lunch near O’Hare one day when they have a layover, and she gets along with them immediately—we are joking around together before the drinks arrive. Is love this comfort, this compatibility? It’s unnerving. It’s too good to be true.
anchor: if I ask a question, Clare just answers it

fact: 他还没告诉 Jasper，也没告诉父母；Clare 也还没把他介绍给女儿。4 月 18 日早上他比平时晚到工作室，Isadora 先开口替他说出「You were with Clare.」——语气平常，好像她明白 Clare 在不和她说话时仍然存在、而 Beck 不在工作室时就是和 Clare 在一起；Beck 本想跟她讲「false dilemmas」，最后只说「Yes, I was with Clare.」
quote: I haven’t said anything to Jasper, or to my parents. Clare hasn’t introduced me to her daughter yet. But this morning, when I arrived at my studio later than usual, Isadora asked me where I’d been, and before I could answer, she said, “You were with Clare.”

fact: Isadora 说「Clare is a wild thing.」，Beck 回「She's in the wild thing club, sweetie.」，Isadora 接「Wild thing, you make everything groovy,」——Beck 当场哭起来，「as though we're going to live happily ever after, after all.」
quote: Isadora said, “Clare is a wild thing.” I told her, “She’s in the wild thing club, sweetie.” Isadora replied, “Wild thing, you make everything groovy,” and then I started to cry, as though we’re going to live happily ever after, after all.

fact: 4 月 24 日（署 Clare）：两人得先喝一点酒，喝完也还是不确定，「no one is in charge, we're both virgins again」；最后她问「Now?」，Clare 答「Yes」，然后两人得自己走进卧室「just . . . begin」。差异在于「she is she and I am not the same me that used to make love to Henry」；她记得从前的害羞与「怕自己不是对方要的」，而这次「I have no assurance from my future beloved that this will all be okay」。
quote: Clare: We have to get a little drunk beforehand, and even then we aren’t sure, no one is in charge, we’re both virgins again; finally she says, “Now?” and I say, “Yes,” ... this time I have no assurance from my future beloved that this will all be okay.
anchor: then we have to walk ourselves

fact: 事后两人并排躺着，有点发懵，不说话；Clare 先笑（出于解脱与喜悦），Beck 起初「alarmed」，随即也领会到「the improbable wonder of us together」，两人抱在一起笑到流泪，「like a rainstorm or a train」。
quote: Beck and I lie side by side, a little stunned, not speaking, because what can be said? And I start laughing, just out of relief, and joy ... until tears streak our faces and the laughing passes, like a rainstorm or a train.

fact: Clare 说「You're perfect.」，Beck 回「Don't burden me with that. Sooner or later I'll disappoint you and what then?」；Clare 开始道歉，被 Beck 嘘住：「Don't worry. Let's just be, here.」Clare 说「Here and now,」，她想说 I love you，「but it catches in my throat」，两人让安静填满房间，然后睡去。
quote: I say, “You’re perfect.” Beck replies, “Don’t burden me with that. Sooner or later I’ll disappoint you and what then?” ... “Here and now,” I say. I want to say I love you but it catches in my throat.
anchor: I start apologizing and Beck shushes me

fact: 5 月 30 日（署 Beck）：Clare 总在他这儿过夜，他猜是因为女儿——Alba 才八岁，「no reason to be too in-her-face about sleeping over」，而且他还没见过她；所以 Alba 住外公或 Mrs. Kim 那儿。但他渐渐起疑，睡前鼓起勇气问：「If Alba is going to stay with Richard or Kimy anyhow, couldn't I come over?」
quote: Beck: Clare always stays at my place. I figure it’s because of Clare’s daughter—she’s only eight, no reason to be too in-her-face about sleeping over. Plus, I still haven’t met her. So Alba stays with her grandfather or Mrs. Kim, and Clare comes to my apartment. ... “If Alba is going to stay with Richard or Kimy anyhow, couldn’t I come over?”

fact: Clare 露出为难；Beck 猜「Is this about Henry somehow? Like, you don't want me trying on his slippers or sleeping on his side of the bed?」，Clare 答「It's weirder than that. I don't want you running into him at breakfast.」两人拿「黑人／女人」打趣：Henry「wouldn't have been minded about the brown, it's the lady part that would have surprised him」、「My lady parts aren't all that surprising」，Clare 说 Henry「never mentioned meeting you」。
quote: “It’s weirder than that. I don’t want you running into him at breakfast.” ... “Henry wouldn’t have been minded about the brown, it’s the lady part that would have surprised him.” ... “Ha. No, he never mentioned meeting you.”

fact: 转折点：Beck 这才想到问「Does Henry show up randomly in your life?」，自嘲「In my cosmos, dead is dead.」；Clare 答他小时候常来，未来还有几次（Alba 说过，或 Henry 提过见过她），但不知道确切何时，且有些是很久以后，「But there might be some I don't know about.」
quote: “Does Henry show up randomly in your life?” It shames me that I haven’t thought of this before. In my cosmos, dead is dead. ... “He used to, when I was a kid. I know of a few occasions in the future—Alba has told me, or Henry mentioned that he’d seen me—but I don’t know exactly when, and some of these meetings are a long time from now. But there might be some I don’t know about.”
anchor: I think I would have a hard time relaxing

fact: Beck 问「Is it like being haunted?」，Clare 答「Maybe?」，侧过身，Beck 从背后环住她；Clare 说「I've been waiting for Henry since I was a child. It's hard to stop.」，Beck 问「Do you want to stop?」，Clare 答「You're here now. I'd like to live in the present, with you.」
quote: “Is it like being haunted?” I ask. “Maybe?” Clare turns onto her side, and I spoon around her. She says, “I’ve been waiting for Henry since I was a child. It’s hard to stop.” ... “You’re here now. I’d like to live in the present, with you.”

fact: 收尾：这事没再提；几天后 Clare 问「Would you like to come over for lunch on Saturday? And meet Alba?」，语气严肃甚至正式，「as though she's asking me to marry her, which maybe she is」，Beck 明白「it is time to get real.」
quote: Nothing more is said about it, but a few days later Clare says, “Would you like to come over for lunch on Saturday? And meet Alba?” She sounds serious, even formal, as though she’s asking me to marry her, which maybe she is, and I understand that it is time to get real.
anchor: Nothing more is said about it
